title: NextAuth.js 設定與 API 路由 (後端)
acceptance: src/auth.ts with NextAuth v5 config: PrismaAdapter, JWT sessions, Credentials provider
bcrypt password hashing on credential validation
Session callback includes user.id and user.role in JWT token
AUTH_SECRET set in .env (generated via openssl rand -base64 32)
dependencies: npm install next-auth@beta @auth/prisma-adapter bcryptjs && npm install -D @types/bcryptjs
verification: Test: GET /api/auth/csrf returns CSRF token. POST /api/auth/callback/credentials with valid email+password returns session cookie.
